originalTitle: Here’s how Bessent’s newly activist Treasury Department is undercutting the Fed’s Warsh
summary: The surprising move this week by Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent to intervene in Treasury markets to lower the cost of government debt undercuts the credibility of Federal Reserve Chairman Kevin Warsh to make interest-rate policy, experts said.
content: The surprising move this week by Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent to intervene in Treasury markets to lower the cost of government debt undercuts the credibility of Federal Reserve Chairman Kevin Warsh to make interest-rate policy, experts said.
chineseTitle: 以下是贝森特新近激进的财政部如何削弱美联储的沃什
chineseSummary: 专家表示，财政部长斯科特·贝森特本周出人意料地干预国债市场以降低政府债务成本，这削弱了美联储主席凯文·沃什制定利率政策的可信度。
chineseContent: 专家表示，财政部长斯科特·贝森特本周出人意料地干预国债市场以降低政府债务成本，这削弱了美联储主席凯文·沃什制定利率政策的可信度。
whyItMatters: 这条信息属于财经市场信号，适合用于观察利率、汇率、股债商品、金融机构和宏观政策变化。
